'''Valdo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was a friend of [[Blackie]], a street person from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Genarius]]. Valdo once accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] someone with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and as a result, he was put on about forty different hit lists.
